facts.fact: President Macky Sall, commissioning the Diamniadio National Datacenter, instructed the government to migrate all state data and platforms to it and to repatriate national data hosted outside the country; state-owned firms such as Senelec are to move their data too.
facts.system: Presidential instruction to migrate state data to the Diamniadio National Datacenter

facts.fact: The report names the Diamniadio National Datacenter, managed by the state IT agency ADIE, as the facility where all government data and applications are to be migrated and hosted; its first phase was due to open in about six months, and no count of bodies moved is given.
facts.system: Presidential instruction to migrate state data to the Diamniadio National Datacenter

systems.tiers: government agencies and state-owned firms such as Senelec; also enterprises and other public bodies
